product.summary: Cypherock X1 hardware wallet that distributes wallet key material across an X1 Vault and four user-controlled X1 Cards.
product.notes: Current official store provides Add to cart / Buy Now controls, supporting on_sale. Initial public launch date remains unresolved.

events.title: Cypherock X1 launched in private beta
events.description: Cypherock states that the X1 hardware vault launched in private beta in 2022.
events.notes: The source establishes private beta in 2022 only. WLR does not convert this to general availability or infer a more precise date.

events.title: Cypherock X1 documented Solana integration
events.description: Cypherock published a first-party product update on 2025-01-20 documenting Solana integration with the Cypherock X1, expanding the hardware wallet's supported network capabilities beyond its earlier private-beta launch state.

evidence.title: Cypherock X1
evidence.notes: Current official store establishes active X1 purchase availability and explains that the X1 Vault never stores complete private keys.

evidence.title: Cypherock Cover
evidence.notes: First-party Cypherock history states that Cypherock X1 launched in private beta in 2022.

evidence.title: Cypherock X1: The Best Solana Wallet for Secure $SOL Storage
